catalog_source.integration: independent fixed-rule reimplementation; repository code is not executed or copied

data.adjusted_ohlc: multiply raw open high low close by adjusted_close divided by raw close
data.execution_and_return: signal from t controls adjusted-close return t to t+1

fixed_variants.macd_ewm_5_34: long when adjust-true EWM5 adjusted close is at least EWM34; repository comparison control
fixed_variants.awesome_zero_line: long when SMA5 adjusted median price is above SMA34 adjusted median price; primary challenger
fixed_variants.awesome_source_saucer_overlay: diagnostic-only repair that lets the source's otherwise overwritten saucer transitions override the zero-line state for one decision
fixed_variants.awesome_inverted: negative control: long where primary Awesome is off
fixed_variants.awesome_stale_1d: negative control: primary signal delayed one additional trading day
fixed_variants.awesome_stale_5d: negative control: primary signal delayed five additional trading days
fixed_variants.awesome_random_matched: negative control: deterministic random active set with the same number of active assets per day

portfolio.weighting: equal weight among active eligible assets
portfolio.turnover: half L1 change including the cash weight

evaluation.weekly_alignment: compound daily returns inside each frozen-core decision/realization week

promotion_gates.awesome_beats_macd_point_estimate: higher annual return and Sharpe with no worse maximum drawdown at 50 bps
promotion_gates.awesome_beats_macd_uncertainty: one-sided 95 percent paired-bootstrap lower Sharpe difference greater than zero
promotion_gates.stress: positive full-period return and both later windows positive at 100 bps
promotion_gates.negative_controls: primary Sharpe exceeds all inverted stale and matched-random controls at 50 bps
promotion_gates.dependence: absolute correlation no greater than 0.80 to both frozen trend v4 and frozen core
promotion_gates.core_blend: 80/20 blend has higher Sharpe and no worse drawdown than common-period core at 50 bps, with positive paired Sharpe lower bound
